claim: FALSE ON PURPOSE. Claims no point of [0,1]^2 has x1^2 - x1 + 1/8 <= 0, on a single leaf. The condition is genuinely negative on part of that box (its minimum is 1/8 - 1/4 = -1/8 at x1 = 1/2), so no sound enclosure may sign it positive there. This is the negative test for the Bernstein branch of range_on_box: the enclosure is only ever used to ACCEPT a leaf, so a bug in it buys false certificates, and unlike the multilinear vertex rule it is not exact.
